s207: The Developer complies with Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI) and other applicable laws, and handles user personal information appropriately.
s208: We collect and process the following information strictly within the stated purposes:
s209:
• Account Credentials (Email & Password): Used via Firebase Authentication only when you opt into Cloud Sync. Passwords are hashed by Firebase and are never accessible to the Developer.
  • Study Records (Subjects, textbooks, problem progress, timer sessions, timetable, goals, exams): Stored locally on-device, and synced to Cloud Firestore only if you enable Cloud Sync.
  • Camera (ISBN Scanner & Optional Study Pet): Used solely for reading ISBN barcodes and on-device person detection for Study Pet. Study Pet never displays, records, saves, or uploads camera video.
  • Location (Optional iOS Location Focus Zones): Used strictly for on-device geofencing to apply focus rules at user-selected places (such as school or a library). Location is never sent to our servers or Firebase.
  • Screen Time Controls (Optional iOS Family Controls): Managed strictly on-device through Apple's Screen Time APIs; selected apps and usage data are never sent to external servers.
  • Book Lookup Queries (Optional ISBN / Title Search): Sent to Google Books API solely to autofill book metadata when you search for a textbook.
  • Anonymous Usage Analytics & Crash Logs: Google Analytics for Firebase and Firebase Crashlytics may collect anonymised diagnostics (device model, OS version, stack traces) to improve app stability.

s212:
• Country: United States (Google LLC headquarters; storage region may vary across Google infrastructure).
  • Safeguards: Google LLC is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, SOC 2 / SOC 3, and ISO 27001, enforcing encryption in transit and at rest (Google Cloud Security).
s213: We never sell or disclose personal information to third parties without your consent, except where required by law or necessary to protect life, safety, public health, or lawful government duties.
s216:
• Encrypted Transit: All client-server traffic is encrypted with SSL/TLS.
  • Strict Access Control: Firebase Security Rules restrict access strictly to each authenticated user's own data.
  • Credential Protection: Passwords are hashed by Firebase Authentication and never visible in plaintext.
s219: You may request disclosure, correction, deletion, or cessation of use of your personal data by emailing the contact address below, or delete your account and cloud data directly in Settings.
s220: Cloud-synced data is stored on Firebase servers until you delete your account. You can permanently delete your account and all synced records anytime inside Settings → Cloud Sync → Delete Account.
s221: The mobile app does not use browser cookies. Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics use anonymous instance identifiers solely for aggregate analytics and crash diagnosis.

s264: Can I use StudyTrail without creating an account?
s265: Yes. All core features—timer, textbooks, spaced review, calendar, timetable, and Screen Time controls—work locally without signup or ads. Only create an account under Settings → Cloud Sync if you want to sync across multiple devices.
s266: How do I log my first study session?
s267: Open the Timer tab, choose a subject (and optionally a material), and start tracking. When finished, tap Finish & Save to log time, ratings, and problem progress—or launch directly from Home → Start Studying.
s268: Does it support Dark Mode, iPad, Android, and multiple languages?
s269: Yes. Choose Light, Dark, or System appearance in Settings. StudyTrail supports iPhone and iPad (iOS 16+ with Split View and sidebar), Android 8.0+, and 50 native languages.
s272: Use Stopwatch for open-ended sessions, Countdown for timed blocks like 25-minute Pomodoro sprints, or Manual Entry to log past study sessions. You can also record per-problem right/wrong results while the timer runs.
s273: Does the timer continue in the background?
s274: Yes. Timing continues when switching apps or locking your screen. On iOS, Live Activities display progress on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, and rotating to landscape opens full-screen focus and desk clock views.
s275: Does Study Pet record or upload camera video?
s276: Never. Study Pet uses strictly on-device person detection—camera frames are never shown on screen, saved to disk, or sent anywhere. The feature is completely optional.
s277: Can I recover a deleted study record?
s278: If you have a backup taken before deletion, restore it under Settings → Backup. StudyTrail also creates an automatic safety snapshot before restoring.
s280: How do the 5-stage problem grid colours and spaced review work?
s281: When you mark questions right or wrong, missed problems are automatically scheduled for spaced review at 1, 3, 7, and 14 days and appear in Home → Today's Review. Tile colours shift across 5 stages from red towards green as you recover mastery.
s282: What if ISBN barcode scanning doesn't detect my book?
s283: Ensure camera permission is enabled in system settings and scan the 13-digit ISBN barcode (starting with 978/979) in good light. You can also type the ISBN or title manually in the search field.
s284: Can I customise subject icons and colours?
s285: Yes. Open the Subjects tab and edit any subject to change its name, icon, and colour. Your chosen colour automatically flows into charts and your timetable.
s287: What blocking rules can I combine?
s288: You can independently enable four rules: during active study timers, scheduled hours (block or free windows), until your daily study goal is met, and inside custom map locations (school/library). You can also earn daily phone time from study sessions, claim goal bonuses, and use timed unlock tickets.
s289: Is my location ever uploaded when using Location Focus Zones?
s290: No. Geofence checks run strictly on-device and location data is never sent to Firebase or any server. iOS requires "Always" location permission only so geofences can trigger while the app is closed.
s291: Can I bypass the Strict Settings Lock once enabled?
s292: Strict Settings Lock intentionally prevents weakening or disabling rules until your chosen end date. Be sure to add essential communication or study apps to your Allowed list before activating it.
s294: How does lesson review in the Timetable work?
s295: Open Study Management → Timetable, set up your term and periods, and tap cells to add classes. Switch to the Review tab to track per-lesson review progress and receive overdue reminders.
s296: Can I set different daily study goals per weekday?
s297: Yes. Under Study Management → Goals, configure separate daily targets for Monday through Sunday alongside your overall weekly target.
s299: How do I add StudyTrail widgets on iPhone or iPad?
s300: Touch and hold an empty area on your Home Screen, tap Edit → Add Widget, and search for StudyTrail to pick from 9 widget types. You can also add them from Lock Screen customisation.
s301: How do I add widgets on Android?
s302: Touch and hold an empty area on your Android Home Screen, open Widgets, and drag a StudyTrail widget onto your screen.
s303: How do I enable Cloud Sync?
s304: Go to Settings → Cloud Sync → Sign In / Create Account. Sign in with the same account on your other iPhone, iPad, or Android devices for delta sync, with a conflict resolution screen if offline edits overlap.
s305: How do I transfer data to a new device?
s306: If Cloud Sync was enabled, simply sign in with the same account on your new device. If you used local storage only, export a JSON backup on your old device and import it on the new one.
s307: How do I permanently delete my account and data?
s308: While signed in, open Settings → Cloud Sync → Delete Account and confirm with your current password. This permanently deletes your account, cloud sync data, and local study data. Export a JSON backup first if you want to keep a copy.
s309: If you cannot access the app, please reach out via the contact section below.
s310: How do I export my records to JSON or CSV?
s311: Go to Settings → Backup → Export. Choose JSON for complete backups and device migration, or CSV for spreadsheet analysis.
s312: How do I import a JSON backup?
s313: Go to Settings → Backup → Import and select your JSON file. Your existing data is automatically backed up beforehand so you can revert if needed.
